original_problem.status: open (Smale's sixth problem for every n); the planar n = 5 case is settled externally
original_problem.statement: Smale's sixth problem: for fixed positive masses m_1, ..., m_n, is the number of planar central configurations (relative equilibria), up to symmetry, finite?
original_problem.priority: n = 3: five central configurations (Euler and Lagrange). n = 4 planar: finite for all positive masses (Hampton-Moeckel 2006, computer-assisted; reproved without a computer by Albouy-Kaloshin 2012). n = 5 planar: finite except an explicit codimension-2 mass subvariety (Albouy-Kaloshin 2012); equal masses were settled separately (Moeckel-Zhao 2019); spatial n = 5: Moeckel 2001 generic and Hampton-Jensen 2011 exceptional list. Since October 2026 n = 5 finiteness for all positive masses is claimed and settled externally by Tomar (arXiv:2610.13100, with a Lean 4 formalization), Chen and Tong (arXiv:2610.16107) and Liu and Liu (arXiv:2610.28168); none refereed; the Lean statement was audited by EXP-024 (faithful, no kernel bypass; the 863 CPU-hour rebuild was not done). n = 6 planar: open, reduced by Chang and Chen (2023 to 2025) to 24 residual zw-diagram cases at mass codimension at least 2; no n = 6 result located [U]. n >= 7: open, even generically. With one negative mass a continuum exists (Roberts 1999), so positivity is necessary. The route to the n = 5 theorem is closed in this programme.
original_problem.prohibited_reframing: No CAOS result may be described as a proof, a new proof or progress toward finiteness for n = 5, which is settled by Tomar, Chen and Tong and Liu and Liu, nor as progress toward n = 6 unless a result on n = 6 is actually obtained. The tropical certificates reproduced here are Jensen and Leykin's, the n = 4 certificate objects are Hampton and Moeckel's, the zw-diagram machinery is Albouy and Kaloshin's and Chang and Chen's, and the Lean proof and certificates audited in EXP-024 are Tomar's. CAOS results are labelled replications, exact instruments, measured limits of routes and the audit of the stated claims.

mission: Build the exact, replayable machine pipeline for finiteness-of-central-configurations certificates, calibrate it on published answers, and state exactly what each route established and where it stopped; the programme is held, and it reopens only on a decided n = 6 focus with a fresh hypothesis and budget (CCB-041) or a decided replay of the Tomar certificates (CCB-040).

focuses.title: Calibration of the exact instruments on published answers
focuses.target: Reproduce in an exact toolchain the n = 3 classification (Lagrange point and the Euler quintic per collinear ordering), assemble the n = 4 planar Hampton-Moeckel system, and decide which polynomial formulation can carry a count.
focuses.value: Every instrument is validated against a published answer before it touches an open case (plan.md, strategy notes). The calibration refuted the bare symmetric Albouy-Chenciner distance system as dimension-blind (the regular tetrahedron and the square coexist) and established the enriched system and the eliminant census as the counting instrument of record.
focuses.success_gate: The exact builder reproduces the Euler-Moulton counts and the Lagrange point, with run.py exiting nonzero on any mismatch (EXP-001), and the enriched system is zero-dimensional with decided censuses classical (EXP-002). Met 2026-07-24.
stop_conditions: A published count fails exact reproduction (it did not on the decided samples).
Engine caps leave the unequal-mass saturation and the full census undecided: instrument upgrade, not more calibration (CCB-007).
focuses.novelty_status: Replication of published objects, labelled as such. The dimension-blindness of the bare system and the enrichment law have no recorded external novelty check: UNVERIFIED.
focuses.manuscript_route: tropical-replication, sections on the calibration and the enrichment law

focuses.title: Replication of the n = 4 and n = 5 finiteness certificates and the limits of direct solving
focuses.target: Reproduce the Jensen-Leykin n = 5 tropical prevariety certificate exactly, screen valuation and equation variants, decide every comet exactly, cross-check censuses between engines, and measure how far direct solves and Groebner dimension probes reach at n = 4 and n = 5.
focuses.value: Opened the tropical lane on validated infrastructure: both published f-vectors reproduced digit for digit, two new working valuation families at n = 5 (powers of 2 and primes), the 257-component count reproduced, every comet decided exactly, and the comet count identified as the monotone invariant. The caps measured at n = 4 and n = 5 fix which routes are closed.
focuses.success_gate: Both Jensen-Leykin n = 5 f-vectors reproduced digit for digit with pointedness verified independently (EXP-003). Met 2026-07-24. The n = 6 run of EXP-005 has no verdict.
stop_conditions: gfan 0.7 fails at n = 6 in both arithmetic modes: an infrastructure barrier, not a budget question (RESUME section 4).
Direct msolve solves of the n = 4 torus census hit the 3600 second cap on both routes (EXP-009); the n = 5 Dziobek dimension stays 5 versus 4 undecided at the declared caps (EXP-013, EXP-014).
focuses.novelty_status: Reproduction of Jensen and Leykin (arXiv:2301.02305) and of Hampton-Moeckel objects, labelled as replication. The two new valuation families and the exact per-comet decision have no recorded external novelty check: UNVERIFIED. The value of the n = 5 tropical replication is superseded by the external n = 5 settlement (strategic review 2026-11-02).

focuses.title: Six-body symmetric stratum: dimension, rank chain, loci bounds and the interval covering atlas
focuses.target: Establish for the open gauged six-body mirror-symmetric stratum (two bodies on the axis, two mirror pairs) the ladder dim(R_j meet shape) <= j for j = 0, 1, 2 on the whole stratum, the step the stratum theorem needs (EXP-022 hypothesis).
focuses.value: A completed chain is the stratum theorem, the nearest sharpening beyond the published n = 6 frontier (CCB-036). The shape variety has dimension 5 ungauged and 4 gauged and the generic rank is 4 (EXP-015, EXP-016); the interval coverings of EXP-021 closed the core with zero residual failures.
focuses.success_gate: The ladder for j = 0, 1, 2 on the whole open gauged stratum, with certified coverings of every region. Not met: the quadruple corner is not closed and several charts are budget stops with unprocessed stacks (CCB-042 verdict, 2026-11-14).
stop_conditions: The Groebner route to the loci bounds is closed at every granularity and characteristic tried (EXP-017, EXP-017b, EXP-017c, EXP-019).
The free-atom chamber relaxation retains 125,097,984 residual assignments and cannot close k = 3 (EXP-020).
The strategic review of 2026-11-02 retired the atlas of this programme as a route to the n = 5 theorem; the open case is n = 6.
focuses.novelty_status: No published closure of this stratum surfaced in the recorded search of 2026-08-01; an unverifiable summary-level diagram count was not imported. External novelty not independently confirmed. Dias-Pan (arXiv:1811.08681) closes the cross strata generically; the relation of this stratum to the 2026-10-30 review's 'doubly symmetric five-body cross' wording is UNVERIFIED.
focuses.manuscript_route: tropical-replication v0.13, the six-body stratum section, stated at the status of the records

focuses.title: Audit of the external planar five-body finiteness claims
focuses.target: Decide whether the Lean 4 theorem MainTheorem_holds of Tomar states the classical claim (finitely many planar five-body central configurations up to similarity for every positive mass vector) and whether any stored or generated source bypasses the kernel.
focuses.value: n = 5 finiteness is claimed by three groups and none is refereed; the statement audit is the one check that can be done without the 863 CPU-hour rebuild, and it fixes what the claim says (CCB-038, CCB-039).
focuses.success_gate: Statement compared with the classical claim and a scan of 2,751 stored source files and 85,756 generated modules for kernel-bypass constructs (EXP-024). Met 2026-11-02: statement faithful, no bypass found.
stop_conditions: The rebuild of the formalization (the author reports about 863 CPU-hours) is not done and not a goal of this focus.
focuses.novelty_status: An audit of another author's formalization, labelled as such; the proof is Tomar's. External confirmation of the five-body claims is not given by this audit.
focuses.manuscript_route: tropical-replication v0.11 onward, the section on the five-body case (EXP-024)

focuses.title: The replication paper at its published version with the corrected atlas status
focuses.target: State in tropical-replication, at a published version, what the replications and the stratum work established and what they did not, with the atlas described by the status each chart actually has.
focuses.value: The CCB-042 verdict found the quadruple corner not closed and that counters read as failed boxes were budget stops with unprocessed stacks; a paper that said otherwise would overstate the stratum work. The corrected statement is generated from the stored summaries and checkpoints.
focuses.success_gate: Tropical-replication published with the chart status classes generated from the stored summaries and checkpoints, the quadruple corner stated as not closed, and an independent review approving. Met 2026-11-14: v0.13, 10.5281/zenodo.24232708, APPROVE after two re-checks (CCB-044).
stop_conditions: No further version while the programme is on hold unless an experiment adds a result or a record changes a stated status.
A stale statement found in the paper (for example by a new external claim) triggers a correction version, not a new experiment.
focuses.novelty_status: Replications and measured limits; the results are internally validated and persisted on Zenodo, which is not peer review. External novelty not independently confirmed.

focuses.title: n = 6 generic-mass finiteness by the tropical route
focuses.target: Decide whether the planar six-body system with generic positive masses has a pointed tropical prevariety (every comet certified), by resuming the gfan 0.8beta computation of EXP-005 with checkpointing, or record a stop with the measured cost (CCB-041).
focuses.value: n = 6 is the only open case left to the programme (backlog CCB-041). A pointed result would give generic-mass finiteness for n = 6, a statement-level result that goes to Felipe first (RESUME section 4).
focuses.success_gate: All comets of the n = 6 prevariety certified pointed by the exact decider of EXP-007, followed by a hardening rerun before anything leaves the repository (RESUME section 4).
stop_conditions: The infrastructure barrier persists: gfan 0.7 aborts in both arithmetic modes and the 0.8beta runs were killed several times.
The measured cost per valuation exceeds the budget declared with the fresh hypothesis.
focuses.novelty_status: Chang and Chen reduce n = 6 to 24 residual diagrams; Jensen and Leykin report their own n = 6 tropical computation as inconclusive; no n = 6 result located in the 2026-10-30 external review [U]. External novelty of any n = 6 result is unconfirmed until searched again.
focuses.manuscript_route: A pointed result enters tropical-replication as a new version; any other outcome is a research record or a stop record.
focuses.first_bounded_action: Freeze a hypothesis and a budget for the 0.8beta pow2 run with checkpointing (written here; CCB-041 states 'needs a fresh hypothesis and a budget before any run').

focuses.title: Independent replay of the Tomar certificates and Lean proof
focuses.target: Rebuild the Lean 4 formalization of Tomar and its certificates independently (CCB-040; done in part by EXP-024).
focuses.value: The rebuild would turn a statement audit into a checked build of an unrefereed n = 5 claim. The review of 2026-10-30 named it a candidate, not a decision.
focuses.success_gate: A complete independent build of the formalization with the axiom check of its main theorem; the author reports about 863 CPU-hours.
stop_conditions: The cost of the rebuild is judged out of proportion to a result that is already claimed by three groups (assessment, written here).
focuses.novelty_status: A verification of another author's claim, never a result of this programme.
focuses.manuscript_route: A paragraph in the five-body section of tropical-replication in a later version; no paper of its own.
focuses.first_bounded_action: Decide, at the next strategic review, whether to run the rebuild (written here; CCB-040 reads 'candidate, not decided').
